balance of the Bond period. In case he fails to serve the new department/ organization, etc., or leaves it before completion of the original Bond period, for a job, where exemption from Bond obligations is not available, the proportionate Bond money should be realized from the individual and refunded to the first department/ organization, etc., with whom he originally executed the Bond.
